hooks.command: if command -v workledger >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec workledger hook SessionStart --harness codex; fi
if command -v workledger >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec workledger hook Stop --harness codex; fi
if command -v workledger >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec workledger hook SessionEnd --harness codex; fi
